_comment: Gap-backlog Patch 2 (Sep 2026 audit). Every field under versions[].manifest was generated by scripts/generate_model_manifest.py reading the real checkpoint - none of it is hand-typed/guessed. 'active' names which version YOLO_MODEL_VERSION/YOLO_MODEL_PATH (.env / deployment environment) should currently point at; rolling back means pointing those two env vars at an older entry's file_name/model_version and updating 'active' here, restarting the service - no code change required (YoloService already loads whatever settings.yolo_model_path resolves to).

known_limitations: Metrics are from the training run's own held-out validation split only - not yet evaluated against real difficult-scenario photos (low light, rain, varied camera angles/distances, crowded backgrounds) per Gap-backlog Patch 2's own further requirement; see docs/AI_MODEL_EVALUATION.md for what has and hasn't been tested.

epoch_reached was not present in this checkpoint's saved fields as a plain integer (-1 in the raw manifest) - epochs_configured (100) is training-run config, not confirmed proof the full 100 were completed without early stopping; not fabricated as a confirmed fact here.

evaluation.real_photo_check: 6 photos outside the dataset (conf>=0.25, top box): pothole-dry pothole 75%; broken-manhole open_manhole 40%; potholes-rain open_manhole 83% + pothole 80%; garbage-stream garbage_overflow 56%; garbage-goats garbage_overflow 47%; pothole-ai pothole 74%. Previous model yolov11-civic-v1.0 detected nothing on all six.

known_limitations: Detects only 3 classes (garbage_overflow, open_manhole, pothole). broken_street_light, water_leakage and illegal_construction were dropped on purpose because no trustworthy public training data was found; those categories are left to the Gemini fallback (GEMINI_CATEGORY_NO_DETECTION path in pipeline.py).
garbage_overflow is weak on street-level photos (test mAP50 0.28): only 120 of its training images are real roadside dumps; the rest are close-up waste items.
Can confuse a water-filled pothole with an open manhole (seen on one rainy real photo).

metrics above are the checkpoint's own final-epoch validation metrics; epoch_reached is -1 because the checkpoint does not store it as a plain integer (training ran the full 80 epochs; best weights kept).
dataset_credits: Pothole images: Brad Dwyer / Roboflow Universe public pothole dataset
Garbage images: AGX (CC BY 4.0) and 'Roadside Garbage Detection' by Akshitas Workspace (Roboflow Universe)
Open manhole images: 'manhole' by air (CC BY 4.0), classes uncovered/broke/lose merged into open_manhole
